verdict.rationale: Kit's V4 API documents a Create Broadcast endpoint that drafts or schedules a send to all subscribers or a subset targeted by segment or tag IDs. Matching update, get (which returns the `send_at` schedule), and delete endpoints for draft or scheduled broadcasts complete the workflow, and API keys or OAuth provide authentication, so the dashboard is not needed. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that end-to-end API scheduling works as documented.
